jobs.description: The Senior Associate – Regulatory CMC, Biocides/Pesticides/Topicals/Collars, works cross functionally with Elanco R&D groups, manufacturing and quality to develop global regulatory strategy, authors submissions, oversees submission preparation and meets the reporting requirements for the Authorization and Maintenance of registrations of new animal drugs with global regulatory agencies. Biocides/Pesticides.Your Responsibilities:- Proven track record of overseeing end to end life cycle management (LCM) of pharmaceutical dosage forms e.g., otic solutions/suspensions, spot-on solutions, pour-on solutions/suspensions and collars- Design/develop CMC regulatory strategy for geo-expansion of marketed products with a focus on creativity and innovation, maximizing the business benefit interdisciplinary project teams, while applying the global strategy into submissions.- Ensure the required documentation and any content, quality and/or timelines for global submissions are communicated to the appropriate teams and tracked according to the functional procedures- Author high-quality CMC documentation for submission, applying CMC global regulatory strategies and assuring regulatory compliance and provide training and mentorship to CMC team members, as necessaryWhat You Need to Succeed:- Degree in Science (MSc, B.Pharm/M.Pharm, Postgraduate in Vet Sciences etc.,)- Min. 5 years in Global Regulatory Affairs, CMC (hands on experience with the Registration process of a variety of pharmaceutical dosage forms is desirable)- Strong knowledge of FDA (CVM), EPA, EMA and ICH/VICH guidelines and regulations governing the authorization and post approval compliance of biocides/pesticides and topical products intended for veterinary use.- Experience in developing CMC Diese Rolle richtet sich an eine zertifizierte Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, die Freude daran hat, internationale Arbeitswelten sicherer zu machen und als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen US‑amerikanischen Exchange‑Strukturen und deutschen/europäischen Arbeitsschutzvorgaben zu agieren.Ihre Aufgaben- Beratung im Arbeitsschutz — Sie unterstützen das Exchange Europe Occupational Health and Safety Program bei der Einhaltung deutscher und europäischer Sicherheitsgesetze und setzen die internen Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien um.- Interpretation und Anwendung von Standards — Sie übertragen nationale Vorschriften sowie OSHA‑Standards in die Exchange‑Strukturen und begleiten deren Umsetzung.- Fachliche Betreuung von Sicherheitsprogrammen — Sie überwachen Programme der industriellen Sicherheit und Präventivmedizin und stellen sicher, dass lokale Sicherheitsstandards in Prozesse und Anweisungen integriert werden.- Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden — Sie pflegen enge Kontakte zu Sicherheitsbehörden, Feuerwehren und Präventionsstellen und fördern die Kooperation in allen sicherheitsrelevanten Bereichen.- Durchführung von Inspektionen — Sie prüfen Einrichtungen, Arbeitsplätze, ergonomische Bedingungen, Arbeitsprozesse und technische Anlagen.- Unfallanalyse — Sie untersuchen Vorfälle, erstellen Berichte und leiten Maßnahmen ab.- Schulungen & Führung — Sie führen Trainings durch und übernehmen die fachliche Leitung von Mitarbeitenden.Ihr Profil- Zertifizierung als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit nach deutschem Recht- Mindestens 2 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung- Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen/europäischen Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzrecht- Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeit- Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftHinweis: Die Stelle kann auf der Ebene C‑7a besetzt werden, wenn die Qualifikationen noch nicht vollständig erfüllt sind.Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber oder Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit gleichgestelltem Status werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt berücksichtigt.++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++The Exchange is part of the U.S. Armed Forces. As a retail organization, the Exchange provides soldiers, civilians, and their family members with all the shopping opportunities they are familiar with from home. In addition to stores offering clothing and everyday necessities, AAFES also operates branded restaurants, movie theaters, and more. The organization also includes a large vehicle fleet, a distribution center, and a bakery.Serves as an Occupational Health & Safety Advisor for the Exchange in Germany.Position incumbent works under general supervision of the Regional Loss Prevention Manager and assists in providing support to the Exchange Europe Occupational Health and Safety Program in complying with host nation safety laws. Complies with Exchange Occupational Health and Safety policies, directives, and regulations.Performs as advisor, technical consultant and coordinator in the application of host nation safety laws and their integration into the Exchange Europe Occupational Health and Safety Program. Interprets safety policies and standards, to include OSHA, for application. Assists with implementation and enforcement of standards. Provides professional guidance on safety requirements.Provides oversight of the Industrial Safety & Preventive Medicine Programs. Assists in ensuring host country safety practices and standards are incorporated into operating procedures, directives, and instructions.Establishes and maintains close liaison with various safety agencies to ensure cooperation with fleet safety, fire protection and prevention, accident prevention, and other matters of concern. Performs plan reviews, conducts compliance inspections to include facilities, equipment, ergonomics and work processes. Advises on the layout of workplaces, processes, and work environment. Recommends corrective actions.Analyzes accidents, conducts investigations, prepares reports and recommendations.May be required to conduct training. Supervises subordinate personnel.MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:Must be certified to act as an Occupational Safety and Health Specialist (Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit) under German law plus a minimum of 2 years’ related work experience. Knowledge of worker-safety provisions of the German/European Labor Safety and Occupational Health laws and rules.Preferred related work experience in the retail field.Position involves travel; driver’s license Class B is required.LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT:Position requires an excellent command of both written and oral English and German language.* Note: Position may be filled at C-7a level if qualifications are not fully met yet.Severely handicapped applicants, or applicants of the same status with the same qualifications, will be given preferential consideration.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Lärmschutz, Fachtheoretische Unterweisung, GefahrenanalyseExpertenkenntnisse: ErgonomieZwingend erforderlich: Arbeitsmedizin, Arbeitsschutz, Unfallverhütung, Arbeitsplatzanalyse, Arbeitsplatzgestaltung

Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Technical Architect Grade 1 (Md8).

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician in the Plant Section of the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics
jobs.description:
The Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics at the innovative Universitetsbyen invites applications for a dedicated laboratory technician. Join our inclusive laboratory and contribute meaningfully as a core member of a research team, mentored by Professor Simona Radutoiu.

We are at the forefront of researching plant-bacterial symbiosis with the goal of unlocking the full potential of both plants and bacteria to foster sustainable and climate-friendly agricultural practices. Our research is funded by ambitious programs, and our team consists of dedicated scientists and students committed to advancing knowledge and achieving project goals efficiently. Our research focuses on understanding the intricate interactions between plants and bacterial communities is pivotal in current research and agricultural needs.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a fixed-term position to start on 1 February 2027 and end on 30 September 2028.

Job description
The laboratories within the Plant Molecular Biology section conduct analyses of experimental plants interacting with various soil bacteria or beneficial fungi, supporting research projects focused on plant genetics and plant responses to microbes.

These analyses include, among other things, DNA and RNA analysis (via amplification and sequencing), the assessment of physiological responses in plants and microbes, and the microscopy of plant cells and organs.

Key responsibilities will include:

• Preparing and conducting experiments in accordance with research hypotheses and objectives.
• Preparing samples from plants and microbes.
• Performing various analyses on samples using DNA/RNA techniques or microscopy.
• Maintaining and operating laboratory equipment and facilities.
• Tasks related to the local work environment, including the preparation of workplace instructions and chemical risk assessments, as well as the labeling of chemicals.
• Updating and maintaining the department’s databases.
• Providing support to postdocs, students, and visiting researchers.
We are a large, international section with a wide variety of tasks; consequently, the actual duties may vary from those listed above.

Your profile
Our ideal candidate:

• Has completed a laboratory technician education (laborant in Danish).
• Has strong experience in molecular biology.
• Has experience with plant research and plant tissue culture.
• Has experience preparing and handling synthetic microbial communities (SynComs) or multi-strain microbial experiments.
• Is proficient in molecular biology techniques such as DNA extraction, PCR, qPCR, gel electrophoresis, and sample preparation for sequencing.
• Can independently design and execute research projects that require care, attention to details and careful observations.
• Is curious, systematic, and thrives in a collaborative, international environment.
• Wants to contribute to cutting-edge plant-bacterial interaction research.
• Can handle complex tasks and maintains overview during periods of intense activities.
• Can assist with data entry and laboratory database maintenance.
• Can manage laboratory inventory, coordinate supply orders, and handle basic purchasing tasks.
• Communicates effectively in English (the working language of our group).
• Has a driving license (min. category B) – preferred.
This position is perfect for someone who enjoys both hands-on lab work and maintaining a well-functioning research environment. If you're passionate about science, enjoy working in a team, and are ready to take on a variety of tasks, we encourage you to apply!

Who we are
The Plant Molecular Biology section's activities focus on genetic, molecular and biochemical research in the model plant Lotus japonicus as well as several crop plants such as cassava, barley, maize, and wheat.

The research seeks to elucidate and understand the mechanisms behind genetic control of signal transduction, cell differentiation, developmental processes, local adaptation and plant-microbe interactions. Key research areas include symbiotic nitrogen fixation, plant perception of microbial signaling molecules, susceptibility to pathogens and colonization by symbiotic and endophytic bacteria/fungi.

What we offer
The research at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics (MBG) at Aarhus University spans from basic to applied research within molecular biology. The department is organised in six research sections (Plant Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics, Neurobiology, RNA Biology and Innovation, Protein Science and Cellular Health, Intervention and Nutrition), a number of centres of excellence and various interdisciplinary centres.

Here, you can:

• Be part of a lively and engaging research environment.
• Work with a large international research network.
• Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge plant molecular biology research.

jobs.occupation: Senior Quantitative Developer - European Gas Fundamentals
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll help design and develop our new European gas supply–demand modelling capability, supporting short- and medium-term trading and portfolio decisions. You’ll combine strong Python development skills with quantitative modelling and market analysis, working closely with experienced energy market specialists and traders. This is an opportunity to shape the technical foundations of an important new modelling capability and see your work directly influence commercial decisions.

Welcome to Forecasting & Market Analysis You’ll join a collaborative team of quantitative developers and market analysts developing fundamental models, forecasts, and analytical tools across European gas and power markets.

You’ll play a central role in building our European gas modelling capabilities, working alongside colleagues with complementary expertise in energy fundamentals, quantitative modelling, and software development.

As a team, we collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we model and understand energy markets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• co-developing and enhancing our new European gas supply–demand model, supporting gas trading, market analysis, and portfolio management.

• designing scalable, reliable Python-based models and contributing to their architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.

• modelling fundamental gas market drivers, including pipeline supplies, LNG imports, storage dynamics, consumption, infrastructure constraints, and cross-border flows.

• developing quantitative methodologies to analyse market balances, assess scenarios, and understand short- and medium-term market developments.

• integrating and processing diverse market datasets, ensuring data quality, transparency, and reliable model outputs.

• improving model performance, automation, testing, documentation, and deployment through modern software engineering practices.

• collaborating closely with gas analysts, traders, and other developers to turn complex market questions into practical modelling solutions.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have strong experience in Python development, quantitative modelling, software engineering, or a related field.

• can design and build scalable, maintainable, well-tested quantitative applications and data processing pipelines.

• have a solid understanding of numerical methods, data analysis, time series, or statistical modelling.

• are comfortable working with SQL, version control, automated testing, and collaborative development practices.

• enjoy translating complex real-world problems into robust, practical models.

• are intellectually curious about energy markets and motivated to understand the fundamental drivers behind market behaviour.

• communicate effectively and enjoy collaborating with people from different technical and commercial backgrounds.

It would be an advantage if you also bring:

• experience with European natural gas, LNG, power, or other commodity markets.

• previous experience developing supply–demand, fundamental, forecasting, or scenario models.

• familiarity with European gas market datasets, infrastructure, and price formation.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

Pre-employment background checks:

For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Do you enjoy turning complex data into clear choices that help VELUX use resources wisely? As S&OP Specialist, you will work across functions to develop scenarios and recommendations that support senior management in making key planning decisions.

Meet your future team

You will join Global Planning – S&OP & Planning Excellence, a team that collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Regional Management, Supply and Finance to support connected planning processes across VELUX. The team consists of six colleagues based in Skjern and Kolding.

The S&OP Specialist is a new role in the team, introduced to ensure better alignment across functions in the planning processes.

What We Offer

As S&OP Specialist, you will support the Global S&OP process by consolidating market input, preparing scenarios and creating decision material and recommendations for senior management. You will bring structure to S&OP preparation and ensure that agreed decisions are translated into clear planning requirements.

As part of your onboarding, you will be introduced and trained in the current Demand Planning processes and tools to build your understanding of the VELUX supply chain and planning processes.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Ensure that worst/best case sales scenarios is agreed and aligned with the regional management in key markets and understand their assumptions, risk and opportunities.

• Support the global Demand Planning Network in coordinating market input, sales uncertainties, campaigns, allocation requirements and scenarios.

• Plan and facilitate Pre-S&OP meetings and prepare topics that require decisions.

• Develop and evaluate scenarios with Sales, Supply, Purchasing, and Finance, including implications for service, inventory, capacity, production, costs and financial performance.

• Prepare clear decision material for Global S&OP meetings, outlining alternatives, business trade-offs, risks and required decisions.

• Document decisions and follow up on actions, deadlines and outcomes, while translating agreed decisions into input for Master Planning.

This role can be based in Skjern, Kolding, Østbirk or Hørsholm and you can expect minimal traveling in Denmark and abroad.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring experience from a planning-related role and understand how decisions on demand, supply, inventory and financial priorities connect across the value chain and have translated that understanding into measurable business outcomes.

You combine curiosity and structure with a commercial mindset and business acumen; you can challenge assumptions constructively and connect planning decisions to customer needs, operational trade-offs and financial performance.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, Supply Planning, Master Planning, Sales Forecasting or Supply Chain Analysis in fast-moving consumer goods.

• Have extensive understanding of S&OP and end-to-end supply chain planning, including how planning decisions affect service, capacity, inventory and production.

• Have advanced Excel skills, experience using Power BI for analysis and reporting, and familiarity with SAP BW/BWP data structures and data extraction.

• Have the financial understanding needed to assess business cases and quantify the implications of scenarios for costs, inventory, revenue and overall business performance.

• Can establish constructive working relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels to ensure that decisions, assumptions, responsibilities and actions are transparent and followed through.

• Can translate data-based scenarios into simple, clear visualisations that enable decision makers to compare options, understand key trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.
